Method of Attack: Deployed as malicious IIS web server extensions/modules to backdoor unpatched Microsoft Exchange servers
Collect information from victims' network and infected devices
Perform Exchange management operations such as enumerating mailbox accounts and exporting mailboxes for exfiltration
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched security flaws in hosted apps
Initial deployment of web shells followed by malicious IIS modules for persistence
Exploitation of vulnerabilities in ZOHO ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus and SolarWinds Orion
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious IIS modules deployed as handlers on Exchange servers
Malicious IIS web server module named Owowa targeting government and public transportation organizations in Southeast Asia and Europe
SessionManager malware active since at least March 2021 targeting government and military organizations across Europe, Middle East, Asia, and Africa
